responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend’s feature metadata table and string-to-feature lookup. This file constructs Feature objects from enum names with their stable names, state, issue number, edition constraint, and descriptive fields, and provides the static name_hash_map/as_name helpers used by the feature-gating pass to recognize crate attributes and produce issue-linked diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Defines the companion header’s declared feature data in executable form: it fills in the switch-based Feature::create table and the string-to-enum name_hash_map/as_name lookup used at runtime, rather than declaring the Feature type and API.
